title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
field: Master's programmes (all fields, with stated exceptions)
about: Leiden University scholarship for non-EEA/non-EFTA students starting a September Master's programme. Applications are due 1 December 2026, alongside an admission application; all applicants hear the award decision before the end of March.
requirements: Excludes Leiden Law School's (non-advanced) LLM and MSc programmes; exceptions for Advanced LLMs and MSc International Relations and Diplomacy
Only for Master's programmes starting in September; February starters are not eligible
Motivation letter as a PDF of no more than 500 words; late scholarship applications are not considered
card_alt: Card for the Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS) at Leiden University in Leiden, Netherlands, with a deadline of 1 Dec 2026. The photo shows a row of colourful gabled Dutch canal houses with houseboats reflected in the canal, a general Netherlands view rather than Leiden itself.
